description: Returns current entries on the official OFAC (SDN and Consolidated), UK, EU, Canada and Australia sanctions lists (Canada/Australia entity-only) whose names or aliases start with the words you give, ignoring case, accents and punctuation. Use it when you have a name; use sanctions_get_entry for a known list and id, and sanctions_list_changes to watch what changed. Inputs: name (required, word prefix of at least 3 letters/digits, e.g. Rosneft), list (optional, one list) and limit (1 to 50, default 20; no paging, so narrow name or list when has_more is true). Output: matches[] with list, id, names, aliases, programmes, countries, first_seen and last_changed, plus has_more and lists[] with official file URLs and check times (about every 6 hours). This is a monitoring aid, not a clearance decision: no match does not clear anyone, the UN list is not covered, and the official lists are authoritative. Terms: read-only; MCP calls are never charged. Without a key, metered routes give 10 successful answers a day free (unmetered routes are unlimited); errors do not count. On the paid HTTP routes, errors and empty answers are free. An optional API key keeps its prepaid-credit policy. When the free answers run out, the error names the HTTP alternative.

list.description: One list only Allowed: ofac-sdn, ofac-consolidated, uk, eu, ca, au; e.g. ofac-sdn.

name.description: Name word prefix, e.g. Rosneft; at least 3 normalized letters/digits; case/accent/punctuation-insensitive; no handler-specific maximum length
